What Markable does

📝

Ingest & Build CLI

Turn a messy Word/markdown draft into a scan-friendly, machine-markable paper with unique question IDs, answer zones, a per-page QR code and a structured marking key — the prep that makes AI marking reliable.

How CLI: markable ingest draft.md then markable build packages/my-test. Or drop a draft in the AI-marking readiness box below to see what needs fixing first.

📐

Rubric Builder

AI-drafts the complete marking key from your test: criteria with marks, accept/reject lists, MCQ answers with distractor notes, and banded rubrics for extended responses — editable on the page, exported as key.yaml or a printable rubric.

How Open the Rubric builder (left menu, under AI cloud). CLI twin: markable rubric draft.md → key.yaml.

✨

Assessment Optimiser

Optimise any assessment for AI marking: unique IDs, explicit marks, typed items and tightened wording — your questions and difficulty preserved, every change logged, with a before/after readiness score.

How Open the Assessment optimiser (left menu, under AI cloud), drop your test in, and download the optimised version. CLI twin: markable improve draft.docx.

🖨️

Scan CLI

Read scanned scripts back in any order or orientation: deskews to the page's registration marks, matches each page by QR, and crops every answer zone.

How CLI: markable scan packages/my-test scans/*.pdf --id-map ids.yaml.

🤖

Mark

AI marks per question across the whole cohort against your key, returning marks, evidence and feedback — anything uncertain goes to a human review queue.

How CLI: markable mark packages/my-test --batch (needs an API key). Nothing below the confidence threshold is auto-finalised.

📊

Report & Dashboard

Scores, item analysis (facility, discrimination, distractors) and a single-file dashboard: cohort KPIs, score distribution and a question × quartile matrix.

How CLI: markable report packages/my-test --dashboard → dashboard.html, then open it from the menu on the left.

🎯

Curriculum Report

Standards-referenced attainment against a curriculum: a green→red outcome heatmap per student, strand rollups, misconceptions and a coverage audit.

How CLI: markable tag … then markable report … --curriculum vc2-science → curriculum_report.html.

🔎

Test Analysis

Point Markable at a test and get a per-item map: marks, strand / concept area, VCAA/ACARA code, cognitive level (Bloom's) and the specific skill each item targets.

How CLI: markable analyse draft.md --curriculum vc2-science → test_analysis.html.

📈

SAC Gradebook

Already have marks in a spreadsheet? Upload a per-SAC results workbook and get an instant multi-tab dashboard — overall, per-SAC question analysis, and per-student skills mapped to the study design.

How Use the Results spreadsheet upload box below — it runs entirely in your browser.

How to use Markable

Markable has two ways in. Most staff only need the first.

🖱️

1. No install — just this page

The dashboard and readiness boxes run in your browser — those files are read locally and never leave your computer. Anything under AI cloud is different: it sends content to your chosen AI provider, and always asks you first.

  1. See your class results. Go to Home & tools → the Results spreadsheet box → Choose spreadsheet and pick your marks workbook (.xlsx). An instant dashboard appears: cohort overview, a tab per SAC/test with question analysis, and every student's trajectory.
  2. Map to the study design. On that dashboard, pick a study design from the dropdown — a Skills & content tab appears showing what each student is performing to. Press ⬇ Download this dashboard to save it as its own file.
  3. Check a test before marking. Use the Test → AI-marking readiness box → drop a test (.docx, .md or .txt). Markable reports how ready it is for reliable AI marking and what to fix.
  4. Read the reports. The left menu under Reports opens each finished report (dashboards, curriculum report, test analysis) right here.

Your spreadsheet needs a row with Surname and one column per question with a /N mark header (the usual SAC layout). Multiple SACs = multiple sheets.

⌨️

2. Full pipeline (the tech person)

For preparing papers, scanning and AI marking, Markable runs from a command line. One-time setup: install uv, then uv sync.

  1. Prepare a paper: markable ingest draft.md → markable build packages/my-test (makes a scan-friendly paper + marking key).
  2. After the test: markable scan packages/my-test scans/*.pdf → markable mark packages/my-test (AI marks per question; unsure items go to a review queue).
  3. Reports: markable report packages/my-test --dashboard, … --curriculum vc2-science, or markable analyse draft.md --curriculum vc2-science.
  4. Power BI: markable powerbi results.xlsx -o powerbi_export cleans the spreadsheet into ready-to-load tables + a build guide.
  5. Bundle it all: markable studio -o markable.html --embed packages/my-test builds this single hub with every report baked in.

Each report is one self-contained HTML file — safe to email, print, or archive. Full commands are on each tool card on the Home page.
